# Mobile advanced searches

Jamf **Reports** for mobile devices: Pro JSON CRUD for the saved search definition (`/api/v1/advanced-mobile-device-searches`) and Classic `GET` for result rows (`mobile_devices` on `/JSSResource/advancedmobiledevicesearches`). Pro GET has **no membership**. Split like computer searches: `mobile_search` is definition-only; `mobile_search_devices` runs the search.

## Agent rules

- Do not use Pro GET `/api/v1/advanced-mobile-device-searches/{id}` for results — that document has no membership. Use Classic `mobile_devices` via `mobile_search_devices` / `results`.
- Do not treat Pro `advanced-user-content-searches` as user inventory searches (Classic `advancedusersearches`). Content searches are VPP (Content Name, Price) and are out of this slice.
- Do not mix with `computer_search*` or Platform `ddm_*` / `benchmark_*` reports.
- Do not add `buddy report`. User searches wait until a user inventory command exists.

## Facts

- List: `mobile_searches(filter?, page?, page_size?)` · `buddy mobile-search list` — Pro paginated `{id, name}`; omit page = all; client-side filter
- Load definition: `mobile_search(id=…)` / `mobile_search(name=…)` · `buddy mobile-search get` / `get id <name>` — Pro JSON; no devices
- Run / results: `mobile_search_devices(id, filter?, fields?)` · `buddy mobile-search results [--fields=…] [--csv] [--id]` — CSV uses spaced headers and omits id unless `--id`; `--fromjson`/`--flatten` for JSON-string cells
- Create: `mobile_search_create(body)` · `create --file=` or `create <name>` — Pro camelCase `andOr` / `searchType`
- Replace: `mobile_search_put(id, body)` · `put <search-id> --file=` — Full Pro PUT
- Delete: `mobile_search_delete(id=…)` / `ids=…` · `delete <search-id> […]` — One or more IDs
- Definition CRUD is Pro `/api/v1/advanced-mobile-device-searches`. Result rows come from Classic `/JSSResource/advancedmobiledevicesearches/id/{id}` (`mobile_devices`).
- Pro list is paginated; CLI list fetches all pages. `filter` on list is a client-side substring on id/name.
- Pass Jamf JSON through: Pro camelCase `andOr` / `searchType`. This is not Classic user searches and not Pro advanced-user-content-searches (VPP content).

## Builtins

### mobile_searches

List advanced mobile-device searches

Returns: list of {id, name}

#### Parameters (JSON Schema)

```json
{
  "$schema": "https://json-schema.org/draft/2020-12/schema",
  "properties": {
    "filter": {
      "description": "client-side substring on id/name",
      "type": "string"
    },
    "page": {
      "description": "0-based; omit to fetch all pages",
      "type": "integer"
    },
    "page_size": {
      "description": "defaults to 200",
      "type": "integer"
    }
  },
  "title": "mobile_searches",
  "type": "object"
}
```

### mobile_search

Load one Pro search definition

Returns: dict

#### Parameters (JSON Schema)

```json
{
  "$schema": "https://json-schema.org/draft/2020-12/schema",
  "properties": {},
  "title": "mobile_search",
  "type": "object"
}
```

### mobile_search_devices

Run a saved search and return Classic device rows

Returns: list of dict

#### Parameters (JSON Schema)

```json
{
  "$schema": "https://json-schema.org/draft/2020-12/schema",
  "properties": {
    "fields": {
      "description": "display-field names to keep",
      "type": "string"
    },
    "filter": {
      "description": "client-side substring on any result field",
      "type": "string"
    },
    "id": {
      "description": "search-id",
      "type": "string"
    }
  },
  "required": [
    "id"
  ],
  "title": "mobile_search_devices",
  "type": "object"
}
```

## Examples

```python
def main():
    rows = mobile_searches(filter="iPad")
    if not rows:
        return []
    sid = rows[0]["id"]
    defn = mobile_search(id=sid)
    devices = mobile_search_devices(id=sid)
    return {"name": defn.get("name"), "matches": len(devices)}
```
